title: AdapterHandoffResult
description: Immutable fact returned by an adapter after a successful synchronous hand-off. It describes how far MEDRE reached the transport boundary; it is not durable lifecycle authority and does not claim recipient delivery.

disposition.description: Synchronous hand-off disposition. 'transport_handoff' means the adapter reached its external transport boundary during deliver(); 'deferred' means work was accepted locally and later facts arrive through DeliveryFeedback.

native_message_id.description: Platform-native message ID when known at synchronous hand-off. Deferred results cannot claim one.

native_channel_id.description: Platform-resolved native channel/room/conversation ID when supplied by the transport. This is evidence, not route identity.

native_thread_id.description: Platform-native thread or parent identifier when supplied by the transport.

native_relation_id.description: Platform-native related-entity identifier when supplied by the transport.

confirmation_level.description: Strongest transport fact proven by the hand-off, independent of durable delivery lifecycle status.

note.description: Human-readable hand-off context. Informational only and never lifecycle authority.

metadata.description: Deeply immutable, JSON-safe, namespaced hand-off metadata. Transport-specific data SHOULD live under metadata[<transport>].
